title: Larger input patches in ViT-G/16 hurt local prediction tasks
description: When scaling to a ViT-G/16 model pretrained on IN22K, the larger input patches do not improve performance on low-level downstream tasks (object counting, depth prediction) and can be detrimental for these local prediction tasks.
canonical_description: larger patch sizes in vision transformers can be detrimental for local prediction tasks

evidence.anchor: detrimental for the local prediction tasks
evidence.quote: Pretraining a ViT-G/16 significantly improves the downstream performances on image classification tasks such as Place205 and INat18 compared to a ViT-H/14 model, but does not improve performance on low-level downstream tasks --- the ViT-G/16 uses larger input patches, which can be detrimental for the local prediction tasks.
